claims.evidence: Witness only confirms 'SONY' and 'PS4' logo on front edge; no 'Pro' marking or model number (CUH-7xxx) visible to distinguish base PS4 from PS4 Pro.
No origin marking, plug type, or voltage label visible in the photo; cannot be confirmed from an image.
No games, cases, or discs are mentioned anywhere in the witness report.
Photo 0 shows two red DualShock 4 controllers stacked on the consoles, though they appear sealed/boxed rather than loose 'used original' pads.

claims.claim: Very clean, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No close-up of console shell, vents, or screws is reported to confirm cosmetic condition or seal integrity.
Functional/thermal claims cannot be assessed from a static photo; no power-on or port close-up shot reported.
No receipt or document is visible in the reported photo.

risks.risk: Console may be base PS4, not PS4 Pro, which changes value significantly.
risks.proof: Clear shot of rear model number plate (CUH-1xxx/2xxx = base, CUH-7xxx = Pro) or system settings screen showing storage/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as base PS4, not Pro.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have port/HDMI/overheating faults.
risks.proof: Video clip of console powering on, booting to home screen, and running a game for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested/for-parts risk, i.e. worst case functional condition.

risks.risk: No games are visible; the '10 games' claim is unconfirmed and could be absent or digital-only (non-transferable).
risks.proof: Photo of physical game discs/cases, or screenshot of library if digital.
risks.if_unproven: Price console/controllers only, exclude games value.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, original box) not shown, which affects completeness.
risks.proof: Photo of all included cables and box alongside the console.

risks.risk: Controllers shown sealed/boxed contradicts 'original pads' from a used console, raising doubt about what will actually be shipped.
risks.proof: Photo of the actual pads being shipped (opened, paired, showing wear consistent with 'used').
risks.if_unproven: Price controllers as unconfirmed/generic, not assumed genuine Sony stock.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition (scratches, dents, disc drive wear) cannot be judged from the angle shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of top, bottom, vents, and disc slot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as average/worn cosmetic condition, not 'very clean'.

risks.risk: No serial number visible, so warranty/stolen-goods status cannot be checked.
risks.proof: Photo of serial number sticker on console base.

proof_requests: Rear/base shot showing console model number plate
Video of console powering on and running a game
Photo of all included cables and any box/packaging
Photo of actual game discs or library screenshot for the '10 games' claim
Close-up photos of console body (top, vents, disc slot) for cosmetic condition
Photo of serial number for verification
response.reason: The witness positively identifies a Sony PS4 console with two DualShock 4 controllers, so it can be priced at worst case (base PS4, unverified function, no confirmed games/accessories) pending the listed proofs.
